sections.title: The letter ji
paragraphs: The letter is named (ji) /ʒi/. It makes the sound in (jupe) /ʒyp/, which means skirt. It has only one sound in French words.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: Push your lips forward into a loose ring. Put your tongue just behind the ridge above your upper teeth. Blow air through the gap while your voice is on. Put a hand on your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: The letter always makes this sound. You hear it at the start of (joli) /ʒɔ.li/. You hear it also in (jeu) /ʒø/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not start the sound with a stop like the letter j in jam. It is smooth like the s in measure. Keep your tongue off the ridge and let the air flow continuously.
